confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Nha Trang tourist pricing; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; accommodation (July peak season, seafront location) is less certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local draft beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX rate comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA overview page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Vietnamese coastal resort cities such as Da Nang and Phan Thiet, adjusted for Nha Trang's seafront tourist pricing. No single comparable city was used.
